title: LeMario: Training a JEPA World Model on Super Mario Bros
summary: This project implements a JEPA (Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture) world model trained on Super Mario Bros, where the AI learns to predict future states of the game environment to enable better planning and decision-making for an agent playing the game.
problem_solved: Trains a predictive world model that enables an AI agent to understand and anticipate game states in Super Mario Bros for improved gameplay planning.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how JEPA world models can learn spatial-temporal representations from game environments, advancing research in model-based reinforcement learning and AI planning capabilities.
